title: TYPES.md frontmatter — workspace.types/v1 (tree node-type registry)
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter portion of a TYPES.md manifest. Exactly one per tree, at the root. Declares the node `type` values a workspace/v2 WORKSPACE.md may use, their allowed parent types, their default wall level, required sibling files, and a 'starter' shape a `ws new` command materializes. Each entry conceptually compiles to an AIP-40 EXTENSION.md; this file is the authoring surface.

schema.description: `workspace-types/v1` is accepted as a legacy alias (AIP-70).

parents.description: Type names this node MAY nest under (nearest ancestor WITH a WORKSPACE.md). Empty array = root-only type.

extends.description: Another type this one inherits unset fields from (e.g. a `client` type extending `project`).

default_wall.description: Wall level a node of this type gets when its own WORKSPACE.md omits `wall`. A node MAY tighten, MUST NOT loosen below this.

max_per_tree.description: Cap on how many nodes of this type may exist in one tree (e.g. root: 1).

requires_files.description: Sibling files `agentproto workspace check` requires at a node of this type (e.g. company → [COMPANY.md]). A project node's status is checked via its `work:` field (AIP-20 WORK.md), not a requires_files entry.

starter.description: What `ws new <type>` seeds by default. Informational to the spec; normative to the CLI that implements `ws new`.

adds_fields.description: Extra frontmatter fields a node of this type MAY carry beyond the base workspace/v2 shape, as a field-name → type-hint map. Validated loosely here; a host MAY compile this into a stricter per-type JSON Schema.
